explanation: Rotation about the x-axis directly gives ⟨x,√(1−x²)cos(θ),√(1−x²)sin(θ)⟩, option d. Its coordinates satisfy x²+y²+z²=1 and cover the entire sphere. Option e also parametrizes this surface by exchanging sine and cosine; options a and b also cover the same sphere because of its symmetry.
